proposed_activation.target_policy: must be absent, with no symlink ancestors; never overwrite or resume during initial activation
proposed_activation.process_model: one-shot materialize, then read-only observe; no daemon or listener
sequence: verify exact candidate, adoption and current tests
verify target absent immediately before execution
observe target and compare full observation
record activation evidence only if both commands succeed
proposed_activation.failure_policy: Stop on first failure; preserve partial target for inspection. Never retry materialize into an existing target.
proposed_activation.stop_policy: Commands exit normally; no service to stop. Preserve event files; deletion requires separate scope.
